page.layout: Two columns with a central list. Left margin: six groups of marginal notes, set beside the list. Centre: a column of names, in groups, with ruled dividers. Right margin: year numbers 1412 to 1419 beside the groups. Page number at the head centre.

marginalia.note: Hisco præpos. Emdanus Groningam venit perriâ electus.
Seditiô cruênta Gronin-gæ duce Coppeno largo.
Keno Brocerm[?], cum exulibus Groningam capit, eiectq; Scitingios.
Kenonis expeditio in Friesiam occiduam, Fadus Groning. cū Langevvoldiis, Fredovvoldiis Hunmereeiis[?] & Octopagiis: item aliud cum Hunesp. & Fivelgoniis.
Aliud fœdus cum idem pro tuenda libertate. Groninga cum tota factione Vetcoperorum proscripta à Sigismundo imp.
Expeditio Foccuconis in Frisia n occid, Colloquia inter factiones de pace fruftranea, Fœderis repetitio inter Groning.& vicinos.

page.notes: Printed page number 22 at the head centre. No running head, catchword or signature. The left-margin notes and the right-margin years are set beside the central list; the year numbers are placed beside the first name of each group. Uncertain readings: "Brocerm" (name of Keno Brock, marked [?]), "Hunmereeiis" (marked [?]), "Schelligh"/"Schellige" (final letter unclear), "Jarichs" (read from Iarichs). "Frisia n occid" is printed with a space, transcribed as printed. The small mark "0" below the list is a stain, not transcribed. Fragmentary or abbreviated words are kept as printed, e.g. "Hunesp.", "Blanch", "epo.".
